description: Unit test class for the Basket entity in the application core, specifically testing the AddItem method behavior.

classes.name: BasketAddItem
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the Basket entity's AddItem method, verifying correct addition and quantity handling.

methods.name: AddsBasketItemIfNotPresent
methods.description: Tests adding a new item to the basket when it is not already present.

methods.name: IncrementsQuantityOfItemIfPresent
methods.description: Tests that adding an existing item increases its quantity.

methods.name: KeepsOriginalUnitPriceIfMoreItemsAdded
methods.description: Ensures the original unit price remains unchanged when adding more of the same item.

methods.name: DefaultsToQuantityOfOne
methods.description: Checks that the default quantity for an added item is 1 when not specified.

methods.name: CantAddItemWithNegativeQuantity
methods.description: Verifies that adding an item with a negative quantity throws an ArgumentOutOfRangeException.

methods.name: CantModifyQuantityToNegativeNumber
methods.description: Verifies that modifying an existing item to have negative quantity throws an ArgumentOutOfRangeException.
